english.title: Include matter in broadcast from outside UK with intent to influence voting
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that, with intent to influence persons to give or refrain from giving their votes at a

(A)_[parliamentary]_
(B)_[local government]_

election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you

(C)_[included]_
(D)_[aided, abetted, counselled or procured the inclusion of]_

a matter relating to the election in a programme service within the meaning of the Broadcasting Act 1990 provided from a place outside the United Kingdom otherwise than in pursuance of arrangements made with the British Broadcasting Corporation, Sianel Pedwar Cymru or the holder of a licence granted by the Office of Communications, for the reception and re-transmission of that matter by that body or the holder of that licence
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 92(2) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
